Soft pieces

Tomato chicken pasta

Paradicsomos csirkés tészta

8 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Offer soft chopped pieces or a mash. Check the chicken for gristle before serving.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 150 g boneless skinless chicken (breast or thigh, diced small)
  • 1 small clove garlic (finely chopped)
  • 2 medium ripe tomatoes (about 200 g, chopped)
  • 100 g small pasta (dry weight)
  • 1 small handful basil or parsley (chopped)
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 4 tbsp water (plain, to loosen the sauce)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Cook the chicken and garlic in the oil until the meat is opaque all the way through.
  2. Add the tomato and water and simmer until the chicken is very soft and the sauce thickens.
  3. Boil the pasta in unsalted water until soft, then drain it.
  4. Stir in the basil or parsley, and do not add salt or black pepper.
  5. Chop or mash the chicken and pasta to the texture the baby can manage.

Adjusted

The usual tomato chicken pasta was salted and seasoned with black pepper, often at 9 or 10 months. Pepper is harsh here, and the pasta and chicken need to be soft enough to squash.

Leave out the salt and the black pepper, and use basil or parsley instead. Keep the chicken and pasta very soft, and chop or mash the portion.
